summary: Rotisserie Champion Detection Bug Fix - All 7 Tests PASS. The bug where season completion returned champion: null for rotisserie leagues despite having a unique season-points leader has been verified as FIXED. The complete-season endpoint now correctly identifies the roto champion ('Zarek's Frozen' with 96.0 pts) when scoring_format is 'rotisserie'.
critical_code_review_comments: seasons.py lines 347-368: Roto champion detection correctly added after team snapshot loop - when scoring_format is 'rotisserie' and no champion found via championship_won_at, it computes roto standings and picks the team with highest total_points
seasons.py lines 357-361: Winning team's championship_won_at is correctly stamped in the database AND the teams_snapshot is updated with the award
seasons.py lines 891-911: Same roto champion detection logic correctly duplicated in _maybe_auto_snapshot_season for auto-complete path
roto.py compute_season function correctly returns totals dict with team_id -> {team_name, total_points} structure used by champion detection
seed_data_creation: Tests use existing leagues: Roto league 69e46af167999bfb85c39629 (Stat Chasers Roto, scoring_format=rotisserie) and H2H league 69e46af167999bfb85c3962b (Perennial Keepers, scoring_format=head_to_head). Cleanup performed after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Roto champion detection bug fix verified. When POST /api/leagues/{id}/complete-season is called for a rotisserie league: (1) champion field is populated with the team having highest roto points, (2) winning team's championship_won_at is set in DB, (3) league_seasons snapshot has champion_team_name set, (4) teams_snapshot awards are updated. H2H leagues correctly return null champion when no championship_won_at exists.
